fusions.name: Draw the Venom
fusions.desc: Strikes one enemy for 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Wormwood Mist
fusions.desc: Releases a wormwood mist over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 3 damage and leaving each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. Half of the damage the poison deals heals you.

fusions.name: Plantain Poultice
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Mithridatism
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You gain 10% poison resistance.
